targets.rawSql: SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName = 'spark-master' AND MetricName = 'metrics_master_aliveWorkers_Value' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName = 'spark-master' AND MetricName = 'metrics_master_apps_Value' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName = 'spark-master' AND MetricName = 'metrics_master_waitingApps_Value' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT sum(Value) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'metrics_worker_coresUsed_Value' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT sum(Value) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'metrics_worker_coresFree_Value' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT sum(Value) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'metrics_worker_executors_Value' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master') * 100, 2) as `spark-master`, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1') * 100, 2) as `spark-worker-1`, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2') * 100, 2) as `spark-worker-2` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.cpu.recent_utilization' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master') / 1073741824, 3) as `spark-master`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1') / 1073741824, 3) as `spark-worker-1`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2') / 1073741824, 3) as `spark-worker-2` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type'] = 'heap' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='metrics_worker_memUsed_MB_Value'), 0) as `mem-used`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='metrics_worker_memFree_MB_Value'), 0) as `mem-free` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName IN ('metrics_worker_memUsed_MB_Value','metrics_worker_memFree_MB_Value') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master') as `spark-master`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1') as `spark-worker-1`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2') as `spark-worker-2` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.thread.count' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='metrics_jvm_G1_Young_Generation_time_Value'), 2) as `gc-young-ms`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='metrics_jvm_G1_Old_Generation_time_Value'), 2) as `gc-old-ms` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName IN ('metrics_jvm_G1_Young_Generation_time_Value','metrics_jvm_G1_Old_Generation_time_Value') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master') as `spark-master`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1') as `spark-worker-1`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2') as `spark-worker-2` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'queueSize' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName LIKE '%Eden%used%') / 1048576, 2) as `G1-Eden`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName LIKE '%Survivor%used%') / 1048576, 2) as `G1-Survivor`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName LIKE '%Old%used%') / 1048576, 2) as `G1-Old` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName = 'spark-master' AND MetricName LIKE 'metrics_jvm_pools_G1%used%' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT Timestamp as timestamp, Body as body, SeverityText as level, ServiceName FROM otel_logs WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
